prompt: We export civil radar altimeters currently caught by USML VIII(h)(10). What changes and when?
assertions: States the October 1, 2026 omnibus proposed rule would remove and reserve VIII(h)(10)
Makes clear nothing has changed yet: the items remain ITAR-controlled while the rule is at proposal stage
States the comment deadline: November 30, 2026 (docket DOS-2026-0991)
Explains that if finalized, the items would transition out of the USML (to EAR jurisdiction) and the final rule's terms should be monitored
Advises maintaining ITAR compliance in the interim and considering a comment submission
